|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/nichubana.html</ref>

You already know [[Sebulba]] doesn't like Jar Jar, but what you may not have known is that [[Sebulba]] doesn't like [[Ketwol]]. [[Ketwol]] is the Light Side character that can exchange docking bays from hand for the top card of the Light Side Lost Pile. This card makes sure that the docking bays won't be retrieved with the [[Ketwol]] engine.

Since this Effect can be started using [[Prepared Defenses]], it can make sure you can get [[Sebulba]] into the action right away, or you can save the once-per-game text to use if Jar Jar makes an appearance so you can give [[Sebulba]] the opportunity to rumble with Jar Jar.
